# Visual Regression Baseline Screenshots

This directory contains the baseline/reference screenshots for visual regression testing.

## ⚠️ Important

Do not manually edit or delete files in this directory. Use the provided scripts instead:

```bash
# Update all baselines
npm run test:visual:update

# Or use the interactive script
./scripts/update-visual-baselines.sh
```

## Generated Files

Files in this directory are automatically generated by Playwright when running:
- `npm run test:visual:update` - Updates baselines
- First run creates initial baselines

## Review Process

Before committing baseline updates:
1. Run visual tests locally: `npm run test:visual`
2. Review diffs in `test-results/`
3. If changes are intentional, update baselines
4. Commit the new baseline files

## File Naming

- `{page-name}.png` - Full page screenshots
- Files are PNG format for lossless comparison
